integrity: The all-parameter result is proved symbolically; standalone programs independently check selected finite cases and should not be construed as external certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula may be expensive to evaluate, is not a classification of all optimizing codebooks, and carries historical-priority risks from unindexed older reversible-code constructions. No distance guarantee or uniform-in-q asymptotic is claimed.
title: Sharp parity-dependent capacity of length-bounded palindromic prefix codes
